```{r module-2-setup, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 1. SETUP ---------------------------------------------------------------------
required_packages <- "tidyverse"
missing_packages <- required_packages[!required_packages %in% rownames(installed.packages())]
if (length(missing_packages) > 0L) {
  stop("Install before running Module 2: ", paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", "))
}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(tidyverse))
source(file.path("R", "helpers.R"))
options(dplyr.summarise.inform = FALSE, scipen = 999)
config <- list( input_file = file.path( "outputs", "synthetic_generator_multiyear", "synthetic_motor_modelling.csv"
  ), claims_file = file.path( "outputs", "synthetic_generator_multiyear", "synthetic_motor_claims.rds" ),
  truth_file = file.path( "outputs", "synthetic_generator_multiyear", "synthetic_motor_full_truth.rds" ),
  output_dir = file.path("outputs", "technical_pricing"),
  # Frozen out-of-time development structure inherited from Module 1.
  training_years = 2021:2023, validation_year = 2024L, test_year = 2025L, cost_basis_year = 2025L,
  expected_policies_per_year = 10000L,
  # Transparent scenario assumption. A 30% loading corresponds to an indicative
  # technical loss ratio of 1 / 1.30 = 76.9%. It is not calibrated to Module 1 truth.
  technical_loading = 0.30,
  # Numerical prediction floors only.
  minimum_frequency = 1e-8, minimum_severity = 1,
  # Broad 2025 out-of-time TEST reasonableness checks, not fitting/calibration targets.
  test_frequency_oe_lower = 0.90, test_frequency_oe_upper = 1.10, test_severity_oe_lower = 0.85,
  test_severity_oe_upper = 1.15, test_loss_cost_oe_lower = 0.80, test_loss_cost_oe_upper = 1.20 )
dir.create(config$output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r module-2-read-input, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 2. READ AND VALIDATE MODULE 1 INPUT -----------------------------------------
# Claims below the excess produce no insurer payment. The fitted models
# therefore use paid-claim counts and severity conditional on payment:
# Module 2 therefore reconstructs:
#   (i) paid-claim frequency; and
#   (ii) mean insurer payment per paid claim.
# This is algebraically coherent for net loss cost and avoids treating valid
# below-excess claims as data errors.
assert_file(config$input_file, "clean Module 1 modelling file")
assert_file(config$claims_file, "Module 1 claim-level file")
modelling_data <- readr::read_csv(config$input_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
claims_data <- safe_read_rds(config$claims_file, "Module 1 claim-level file")
required_columns <- c( "policy_id", "quote_profile_id", "policy_year", "data_split", "state", "remoteness_area",
  "driver_age", "licence_years", "vehicle_age", "vehicle_segment", "motive_power",
  "engine_capacity_l", "cylinder_count", "power_kw", "torque_nm", "unladen_weight_kg", "transmission",
  "vehicle_value", "annual_km", "voluntary_excess", "exposure",
  "prior_claims_5yr", "claim_free_years", "claim_count", "incurred_claim_cost", "average_paid_claim_cost" )
assert_columns(modelling_data, required_columns, "synthetic_motor_modelling.csv")
assert_columns( claims_data, c("policy_id", "policy_year", "claim_number", "incurred_claim_cost"),
  "synthetic_motor_claims.rds" )
if (nrow(modelling_data) == 0L) stop("Module 1 modelling file contains zero rows.")
if (anyDuplicated(modelling_data$policy_id)) stop("policy_id is not unique.")
if (anyDuplicated(modelling_data$quote_profile_id)) stop("quote_profile_id is not unique.")
modelling_data <- modelling_data %>% mutate( policy_year = as.integer(policy_year),
    data_split = tolower(trimws(as.character(data_split))) )
claims_data <- claims_data %>% mutate( policy_year = as.integer(policy_year),
    incurred_claim_cost = as.numeric(incurred_claim_cost) )
if (any(!is.finite(claims_data$incurred_claim_cost)) ||
    any(claims_data$incurred_claim_cost < 0)) {
  stop("Claim-level incurred_claim_cost contains invalid values.")
}
expected_policy_years <- c(config$training_years, config$validation_year, config$test_year)
if (!setequal(sort(unique(modelling_data$policy_year)), expected_policy_years)) {
  stop( "Module 2 requires policy years 2021-2025 only. Observed years: ",
    paste(sort(unique(modelling_data$policy_year)), collapse = ", ") )
}
expected_split_by_year <- case_when( modelling_data$policy_year %in% config$training_years ~ "train",
  modelling_data$policy_year == config$validation_year ~ "validation",
  modelling_data$policy_year == config$test_year ~ "test", TRUE ~ NA_character_ )
if (anyNA(expected_split_by_year)) {
  stop("Unable to assign the frozen out-of-time split to every policy year.")
}
if (!all(modelling_data$data_split == expected_split_by_year)) {
  stop( paste( "Module 2 temporal split does not match the frozen design:",
      "2021-2023 TRAIN, 2024 VALIDATION, 2025 TEST." ) )
}
expected_splits <- c("train", "validation", "test")
missing_splits <- setdiff(expected_splits, unique(modelling_data$data_split))
if (length(missing_splits) > 0L) {
  stop("Missing required data split(s): ", paste(missing_splits, collapse = ", "))
}
vehicle_spec_numeric_fields <- c(
  "engine_capacity_l", "cylinder_count", "power_kw", "torque_nm", "unladen_weight_kg" )
nonfinite_vehicle_spec <- vehicle_spec_numeric_fields[
  map_lgl(vehicle_spec_numeric_fields, ~ any(!is.finite(modelling_data[[.x]]))) ]
if (length(nonfinite_vehicle_spec) > 0L) {
  stop( "Module 1 contains non-finite vehicle specification values: ",
    paste(nonfinite_vehicle_spec, collapse = ", ") )
}
if (any(modelling_data$engine_capacity_l < 0) || any(modelling_data$cylinder_count < 0) ||
    any(modelling_data$power_kw <= 0) || any(modelling_data$torque_nm <= 0) ||
    any(modelling_data$unladen_weight_kg <= 0)) {
  stop("Module 1 contains invalid vehicle specification values.")
}
if (anyNA(modelling_data$transmission) ||
    any(trimws(as.character(modelling_data$transmission)) == "")) {
  stop("Module 1 transmission contains missing/blank values.")
}
if (any(!is.finite(modelling_data$incurred_claim_cost)) ||
    any(modelling_data$incurred_claim_cost < 0)) {
  stop("Policy-level incurred_claim_cost contains invalid values.")
}
# Reconstruct reported and positive-paid claims from the claim-level file.
claim_pricing_summary <- claims_data %>% group_by(policy_id) %>% summarise(
    reconstructed_reported_claim_count = n(), pricing_claim_count = sum(incurred_claim_cost > 0),
    reconstructed_incurred_claim_cost = sum(incurred_claim_cost), pricing_average_paid_claim_cost = if_else(
      pricing_claim_count > 0, reconstructed_incurred_claim_cost / pricing_claim_count, NA_real_ ),
    .groups = "drop" )
modelling_data <- modelling_data %>% left_join(claim_pricing_summary, by = "policy_id") %>% mutate(
    reconstructed_reported_claim_count = replace_na( reconstructed_reported_claim_count, 0L ),
    pricing_claim_count = replace_na(pricing_claim_count, 0L), reconstructed_incurred_claim_cost = replace_na(
      reconstructed_incurred_claim_cost, 0 ), pricing_average_paid_claim_cost = if_else( pricing_claim_count > 0,
      pricing_average_paid_claim_cost, NA_real_ ) )
reported_count_mismatch <- sum( modelling_data$claim_count != modelling_data$reconstructed_reported_claim_count )
incurred_reconstruction_error <- max( abs( modelling_data$incurred_claim_cost -
      modelling_data$reconstructed_incurred_claim_cost ) )
if (reported_count_mismatch > 0L) {
  stop( "Claim-level file does not reconcile to policy-level reported claim_count for ",
    reported_count_mismatch, " policies." )
}
if (!is.finite(incurred_reconstruction_error) ||
    incurred_reconstruction_error > 0.011) {
  stop( "Claim-level incurred costs do not reconcile to policy-level incurred costs. ",
    "Maximum absolute difference = ", incurred_reconstruction_error )
}
if (any(modelling_data$pricing_claim_count > modelling_data$claim_count)) {
  stop("Positive-paid claim count cannot exceed reported claim count.")
}
if (any( modelling_data$pricing_claim_count > 0 & (!is.finite(modelling_data$pricing_average_paid_claim_cost) |
       modelling_data$pricing_average_paid_claim_cost <= 0)
)) {
  stop("Positive-paid claims contain invalid pricing severity values.")
}
zero_paid_reported_claims <- sum(modelling_data$claim_count) - sum(modelling_data$pricing_claim_count)
# Module 1 deliberately supplies incurred costs on a common 2025 AUD basis.
claims_cost_basis_label <- paste0( config$cost_basis_year, " AUD (Module 1 on-levelled)" )
frequency_definition_label <- "Positive insurer-paid claims after voluntary excess"
severity_definition_label <- "Mean insurer-paid cost conditional on positive payment"
```

```{r module-2-leakage-controls, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 3. LEAKAGE CONTROLS ----------------------------------------------------------
forbidden_truth_columns <- names(modelling_data)[str_detect( names(modelling_data),
  regex("^true_|frailty|^latent_|^premium_loading_factor$|^technical_premium$", ignore_case = TRUE) )]
if (length(forbidden_truth_columns) > 0L) {
  stop( "Module 2 input contains forbidden truth/latent columns: ", paste(forbidden_truth_columns, collapse = ", ")
  )
}
# Defensive compatibility only; the clean Module 1 file already removes this.
if ("driver_sex_audit" %in% names(modelling_data)) {
  warning("driver_sex_audit was present and has been removed from Module 2 input.")
  modelling_data <- modelling_data %>% select(-driver_sex_audit)
}
```

```{r module-2-prepare-features, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 4. PREPARE OBSERVABLE PRICING FEATURES --------------------------------------
modelling_data <- modelling_data %>% mutate( data_split = factor(data_split, levels = expected_splits),
    state = factor(state), remoteness_area = factor(remoteness_area), vehicle_segment = factor(vehicle_segment),
    motive_power = factor(motive_power), transmission = factor(transmission),
    excess_factor = factor(voluntary_excess), prior_claims_band = case_when( prior_claims_5yr <= 0 ~ "0",
      prior_claims_5yr == 1 ~ "1", prior_claims_5yr == 2 ~ "2", prior_claims_5yr == 3 ~ "3", TRUE ~ "4+" ),
    prior_claims_band = factor(prior_claims_band, levels = c("0", "1", "2", "3", "4+")),
    log_annual_km = log(pmax(annual_km, 1)), log_vehicle_value = log(pmax(vehicle_value, 1)) )
if (any(!is.finite(modelling_data$log_annual_km)) ||
    any(!is.finite(modelling_data$log_vehicle_value))) {
  stop("Non-finite transformed pricing features detected.")
}
if (any(modelling_data$exposure <= 0)) stop("Exposure must be strictly positive.")
# Use calendar year directly for development partitions so accidental split-label
# changes cannot move future observations into model development.
training_data <- modelling_data %>% filter(policy_year %in% config$training_years)
validation_data <- modelling_data %>% filter(policy_year == config$validation_year)
test_data <- modelling_data %>% filter(policy_year == config$test_year)
development_data <- modelling_data %>% filter(policy_year %in% c(config$training_years, config$validation_year))
expected_training_rows <- length(config$training_years) * config$expected_policies_per_year
expected_validation_rows <- config$expected_policies_per_year
expected_test_rows <- config$expected_policies_per_year
expected_development_rows <- expected_training_rows + expected_validation_rows
if (nrow(training_data) != expected_training_rows) {
  stop( "TRAIN must contain exactly ", expected_training_rows,
    " policies from 2021-2023; observed ", nrow(training_data), "." )
}
if (nrow(validation_data) != expected_validation_rows) {
  stop( "VALIDATION must contain exactly ", expected_validation_rows,
    " policies from 2024; observed ", nrow(validation_data), "." )
}
if (nrow(test_data) != expected_test_rows) {
  stop( "TEST must contain exactly ", expected_test_rows, " policies from 2025; observed ", nrow(test_data), "." )
}
if (nrow(development_data) != expected_development_rows) {
  stop( "DEVELOPMENT must contain exactly ", expected_development_rows,
    " policies from 2021-2024; observed ", nrow(development_data), "." )
}
development_test_overlap <- intersect(development_data$policy_id, test_data$policy_id)
if (length(development_test_overlap) > 0L) {
  stop("2025 TEST policies have leaked into the 2021-2024 development sample.")
}
if (!all(training_data$policy_year %in% config$training_years) ||
    !all(validation_data$policy_year == config$validation_year) ||
    !all(test_data$policy_year == config$test_year) ||
    !all(development_data$policy_year <= config$validation_year)) {
  stop("Calendar-year development partition failed an internal consistency check.")
}
```

```{r module-2-factor-support, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 5. FACTOR-LEVEL SUPPORT ------------------------------------------------------
factor_variables <- c( "state", "remoteness_area", "vehicle_segment", "motive_power", "transmission",
  "excess_factor", "prior_claims_band" )
training_factor_level_check <- map_dfr(factor_variables, function(variable_name) {
  full_values <- modelling_data[[variable_name]]
  train_values <- training_data[[variable_name]]
  full_levels <- levels(full_values)
  tibble( variable = variable_name, level = full_levels,
    full_count = map_int(full_levels, ~ sum(as.character(full_values) == .x)),
    training_count = map_int(full_levels, ~ sum(as.character(train_values) == .x)) )
})
unsupported_training_levels <- training_factor_level_check %>% filter(full_count > 0, training_count == 0)
if (nrow(unsupported_training_levels) > 0L) {
  stop("At least one factor level is present in the portfolio but absent from TRAIN.")
}
```

```{r module-2-frequency-models, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 6. FREQUENCY MODEL DEVELOPMENT: 2021-2023 TRAIN -> 2024 VALIDATION ---------
# The pricing frequency outcome is the number of claims with positive insurer-paid
# incurred cost after the voluntary excess. This aligns the frequency component
# with the strictly positive Gamma severity component.
frequency_model_definitions <- list( "Frequency benchmark" =
    pricing_claim_count ~ driver_age + licence_years + log_annual_km +
      prior_claims_band + state + remoteness_area + offset(log(exposure)), "Frequency flexible" =
    pricing_claim_count ~ splines::ns(driver_age, df = 4) + splines::ns(licence_years, df = 3) +
      splines::ns(log_annual_km, df = 3) + prior_claims_band + state +
      remoteness_area + vehicle_segment + offset(log(exposure)), "Frequency flexible + motive power" =
    pricing_claim_count ~ splines::ns(driver_age, df = 4) + splines::ns(licence_years, df = 3) +
      splines::ns(log_annual_km, df = 3) + prior_claims_band + state +
      remoteness_area + vehicle_segment + motive_power + offset(log(exposure)),
  "Frequency flexible + vehicle specifications" = pricing_claim_count ~ splines::ns(driver_age, df = 4) +
      splines::ns(licence_years, df = 3) + splines::ns(log_annual_km, df = 3) + prior_claims_band + state +
      remoteness_area + vehicle_segment + motive_power + transmission +
      splines::ns(engine_capacity_l, df = 3) + cylinder_count +
      splines::ns(power_kw, df = 3) + splines::ns(torque_nm, df = 3) +
      splines::ns(unladen_weight_kg, df = 3) + offset(log(exposure)) )
frequency_models <- imap(frequency_model_definitions, function(model_formula, model_name) {
  fit <- glm( model_formula, data = training_data, family = quasipoisson(link = "log"),
    control = glm.control(maxit = 100) )
  if (!isTRUE(fit$converged)) stop(model_name, " did not converge.")
  fit
})
frequency_model_comparison <- imap_dfr(frequency_models, function(model_object, model_name) {
  pred <- pmax( predict(model_object, newdata = validation_data, type = "response"), config$minimum_frequency )
  tibble( model = model_name, observed_claim_count = sum(validation_data$pricing_claim_count),
    predicted_claim_count = sum(pred), observed_to_expected = safe_divide(
      sum(validation_data$pricing_claim_count), sum(pred) ), mean_poisson_deviance = mean_poisson_deviance(
      validation_data$pricing_claim_count, pred ), rmse = rmse(validation_data$pricing_claim_count, pred),
    mae = mae(validation_data$pricing_claim_count, pred) )
}) %>% arrange(mean_poisson_deviance)
selected_frequency_model_name <- frequency_model_comparison$model[[1]]
selected_frequency_formula <- frequency_model_definitions[[selected_frequency_model_name]]
```

```{r module-2-severity-models, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 7. SEVERITY MODEL DEVELOPMENT: 2021-2023 TRAIN -> 2024 VALIDATION ----------
# Severity uses a Gamma GLM with log link on policies with at least one positive
# insurer payment. pricing_average_paid_claim_cost is reconstructed from the
# claim-level Module 1 file using positive-paid claims only; weighting by
# pricing_claim_count gives each positive-paid realised claim equal influence.
claimant_filter <- function(data) {
  data %>% filter( pricing_claim_count > 0, is.finite(pricing_average_paid_claim_cost),
      pricing_average_paid_claim_cost > 0 )
}
training_claimants <- claimant_filter(training_data)
validation_claimants <- claimant_filter(validation_data)
development_claimants <- claimant_filter(development_data)
if (nrow(training_claimants) == 0L || nrow(validation_claimants) == 0L) {
  stop("Insufficient positive-paid claim observations for severity modelling.")
}
severity_model_definitions <- list( "Severity benchmark" =
    pricing_average_paid_claim_cost ~ log_vehicle_value + excess_factor + vehicle_segment, "Severity flexible" =
    pricing_average_paid_claim_cost ~ splines::ns(log_vehicle_value, df = 4) +
      splines::ns(vehicle_age, df = 3) + excess_factor + vehicle_segment, "Severity flexible + motive power" =
    pricing_average_paid_claim_cost ~ splines::ns(log_vehicle_value, df = 4) +
      splines::ns(vehicle_age, df = 3) + excess_factor + vehicle_segment + motive_power,
  "Severity flexible + vehicle specifications" =
    pricing_average_paid_claim_cost ~ splines::ns(log_vehicle_value, df = 4) +
      splines::ns(vehicle_age, df = 3) + excess_factor + vehicle_segment + motive_power + transmission +
      splines::ns(engine_capacity_l, df = 3) + cylinder_count +
      splines::ns(power_kw, df = 3) + splines::ns(torque_nm, df = 3) + splines::ns(unladen_weight_kg, df = 3) )
severity_models <- imap(severity_model_definitions, function(model_formula, model_name) {
  fit <- glm( model_formula, data = training_claimants, weights = pricing_claim_count,
    family = Gamma(link = "log"), control = glm.control(maxit = 100) )
  if (!isTRUE(fit$converged)) stop(model_name, " did not converge.")
  fit
})
severity_model_comparison <- imap_dfr(severity_models, function(model_object, model_name) {
  pred <- pmax( predict(model_object, newdata = validation_claimants, type = "response"), config$minimum_severity )
  tibble( model = model_name, observed_total_claim_cost = sum(validation_claimants$incurred_claim_cost),
    predicted_total_claim_cost = sum( pred * validation_claimants$pricing_claim_count ),
    observed_to_expected = safe_divide( sum(validation_claimants$incurred_claim_cost),
      sum(pred * validation_claimants$pricing_claim_count) ), mean_gamma_deviance = mean_gamma_deviance(
      validation_claimants$pricing_average_paid_claim_cost, pred, validation_claimants$pricing_claim_count ),
    weighted_rmse = rmse( validation_claimants$pricing_average_paid_claim_cost, pred,
      validation_claimants$pricing_claim_count ), weighted_mae = mae(
      validation_claimants$pricing_average_paid_claim_cost, pred, validation_claimants$pricing_claim_count ) )
}) %>% arrange(mean_gamma_deviance)
selected_severity_model_name <- severity_model_comparison$model[[1]]
selected_severity_formula <- severity_model_definitions[[selected_severity_model_name]]
# Retain incremental predictor-block results in the compact summary/metadata.
frequency_base <- frequency_model_comparison %>% filter(model == "Frequency flexible")
frequency_mp <- frequency_model_comparison %>% filter(model == "Frequency flexible + motive power")
frequency_specs <- frequency_model_comparison %>% filter(model == "Frequency flexible + vehicle specifications")
severity_base <- severity_model_comparison %>% filter(model == "Severity flexible")
severity_mp <- severity_model_comparison %>% filter(model == "Severity flexible + motive power")
severity_specs <- severity_model_comparison %>% filter(model == "Severity flexible + vehicle specifications")
frequency_uses_motive_power <- selected_frequency_model_name %in% c( "Frequency flexible + motive power",
  "Frequency flexible + vehicle specifications" )
severity_uses_motive_power <- selected_severity_model_name %in% c( "Severity flexible + motive power",
  "Severity flexible + vehicle specifications" )
frequency_uses_vehicle_specs <- identical( selected_frequency_model_name,
  "Frequency flexible + vehicle specifications" )
severity_uses_vehicle_specs <- identical( selected_severity_model_name,
  "Severity flexible + vehicle specifications" )
motive_power_incremental_value <- bind_rows( tibble( component = "Frequency", base_model = "Frequency flexible",
    enriched_model = "Frequency flexible + motive power", base_deviance = frequency_base$mean_poisson_deviance,
    enriched_deviance = frequency_mp$mean_poisson_deviance, relative_deviance_improvement = safe_divide(
      frequency_base$mean_poisson_deviance - frequency_mp$mean_poisson_deviance,
      frequency_base$mean_poisson_deviance ) ), tibble( component = "Severity", base_model = "Severity flexible",
    enriched_model = "Severity flexible + motive power", base_deviance = severity_base$mean_gamma_deviance,
    enriched_deviance = severity_mp$mean_gamma_deviance, relative_deviance_improvement = safe_divide(
      severity_base$mean_gamma_deviance - severity_mp$mean_gamma_deviance, severity_base$mean_gamma_deviance ) ) )
vehicle_specification_incremental_value <- bind_rows( tibble( component = "Frequency",
    base_model = "Frequency flexible + motive power",
    enriched_model = "Frequency flexible + vehicle specifications",
    base_deviance = frequency_mp$mean_poisson_deviance, enriched_deviance = frequency_specs$mean_poisson_deviance,
    relative_deviance_improvement = safe_divide(
      frequency_mp$mean_poisson_deviance - frequency_specs$mean_poisson_deviance,
      frequency_mp$mean_poisson_deviance ) ), tibble( component = "Severity",
    base_model = "Severity flexible + motive power", enriched_model = "Severity flexible + vehicle specifications",
    base_deviance = severity_mp$mean_gamma_deviance, enriched_deviance = severity_specs$mean_gamma_deviance,
    relative_deviance_improvement = safe_divide(
      severity_mp$mean_gamma_deviance - severity_specs$mean_gamma_deviance, severity_mp$mean_gamma_deviance ) ) )
```

```{r module-2-refit-models, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 8. REFIT SELECTED MODELS ON 2021-2024 DEVELOPMENT SAMPLE --------------------
# Candidate specifications were selected using 2024 VALIDATION performance only.
# After selection, the winning formulas are refitted on all information available
# before the 2025 out-of-time TEST year.
final_frequency_model <- glm( selected_frequency_formula, data = development_data,
  family = quasipoisson(link = "log"), control = glm.control(maxit = 100) )
if (!isTRUE(final_frequency_model$converged)) stop("Final frequency model did not converge.")
final_severity_model <- glm( selected_severity_formula, data = development_claimants,
  weights = pricing_claim_count, family = Gamma(link = "log"), control = glm.control(maxit = 100) )
if (!isTRUE(final_severity_model$converged)) stop("Final severity model did not converge.")
frequency_dispersion <- summary(final_frequency_model)$dispersion
severity_dispersion <- summary(final_severity_model)$dispersion
```

```{r module-2-balancing, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 9. 2021-2024 DEVELOPMENT-SAMPLE BALANCING -----------------------------------
# Multiplicative calibration is estimated only on 2021-2024 DEVELOPMENT data.
# The 2025 TEST cohort is untouched. Frequency is balanced to positive-paid claim
# counts and severity to the corresponding positive-paid aggregate claim cost.
development_frequency_raw <- predict( final_frequency_model, newdata = development_data, type = "response" )
frequency_balance_factor <- safe_divide( sum(development_data$pricing_claim_count), sum(development_frequency_raw)
)
development_severity_raw <- predict( final_severity_model, newdata = development_claimants, type = "response" )
severity_balance_factor <- safe_divide( sum(development_claimants$incurred_claim_cost), sum(
    development_severity_raw * development_claimants$pricing_claim_count ) )
if (!is.finite(frequency_balance_factor) || frequency_balance_factor <= 0) {
  stop("Invalid frequency balance factor.")
}
if (!is.finite(severity_balance_factor) || severity_balance_factor <= 0) {
  stop("Invalid severity balance factor.")
}
```

```{r module-2-final-predictions, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 10. FINAL PREDICTIONS AND TECHNICAL PREMIUM ---------------------------------
estimated_claim_frequency <- pmax(
  predict(final_frequency_model, newdata = modelling_data, type = "response") * frequency_balance_factor,
  config$minimum_frequency )
estimated_claim_severity <- pmax(
  predict(final_severity_model, newdata = modelling_data, type = "response") * severity_balance_factor,
  config$minimum_severity )
estimated_expected_claim_cost <- estimated_claim_frequency * estimated_claim_severity
technical_premium <- estimated_expected_claim_cost * (1 + config$technical_loading)
if (any(!is.finite(estimated_claim_frequency)) || any(!is.finite(estimated_claim_severity)) ||
    any(!is.finite(estimated_expected_claim_cost)) || any(!is.finite(technical_premium)) ||
    any(technical_premium <= 0)) {
  stop("Invalid technical-pricing predictions were generated.")
}
evaluation_data <- modelling_data %>% mutate( estimated_claim_frequency = estimated_claim_frequency,
    estimated_claimant_probability = 1 - exp(-estimated_claim_frequency),
    estimated_claim_severity = estimated_claim_severity,
    estimated_expected_claim_cost = estimated_expected_claim_cost, technical_loading = config$technical_loading,
    technical_premium = technical_premium )
```

```{r module-2-test-evaluation, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 11. HELD-OUT 2025 OUT-OF-TIME TEST EVALUATION -------------------------------
test_results <- evaluation_data %>% filter(policy_year == config$test_year)
if (nrow(test_results) != expected_test_rows) {
  stop("Final 2025 TEST extraction did not preserve the full out-of-time cohort.")
}
test_claimants <- claimant_filter(test_results)
test_frequency_metrics <- tibble( component = "Positive-paid claim frequency", observations = nrow(test_results),
  observed = sum(test_results$pricing_claim_count), predicted = sum(test_results$estimated_claim_frequency),
  observed_to_expected = safe_divide( sum(test_results$pricing_claim_count),
    sum(test_results$estimated_claim_frequency) ), deviance = mean_poisson_deviance(
    test_results$pricing_claim_count, test_results$estimated_claim_frequency ), rmse = rmse(
    test_results$pricing_claim_count, test_results$estimated_claim_frequency ), mae = mae(
    test_results$pricing_claim_count, test_results$estimated_claim_frequency ) )
test_severity_metrics <- tibble( component = "Positive-paid claim severity", observations = nrow(test_claimants),
  observed = sum(test_claimants$incurred_claim_cost), predicted = sum( test_claimants$estimated_claim_severity *
      test_claimants$pricing_claim_count ), observed_to_expected = safe_divide(
    sum(test_claimants$incurred_claim_cost), sum( test_claimants$estimated_claim_severity *
        test_claimants$pricing_claim_count ) ), deviance = mean_gamma_deviance(
    test_claimants$pricing_average_paid_claim_cost, test_claimants$estimated_claim_severity,
    test_claimants$pricing_claim_count ), rmse = rmse( test_claimants$pricing_average_paid_claim_cost,
    test_claimants$estimated_claim_severity, test_claimants$pricing_claim_count ), mae = mae(
    test_claimants$pricing_average_paid_claim_cost, test_claimants$estimated_claim_severity,
    test_claimants$pricing_claim_count ) )
test_loss_cost_metrics <- tibble( component = "Expected annual claims cost", observations = nrow(test_results),
  observed = sum(test_results$incurred_claim_cost), predicted = sum(test_results$estimated_expected_claim_cost),
  observed_to_expected = safe_divide( sum(test_results$incurred_claim_cost),
    sum(test_results$estimated_expected_claim_cost) ), deviance = NA_real_, rmse = rmse(
    test_results$incurred_claim_cost, test_results$estimated_expected_claim_cost ), mae = mae(
    test_results$incurred_claim_cost, test_results$estimated_expected_claim_cost ) )
technical_pricing_test_metrics <- bind_rows( test_frequency_metrics, test_severity_metrics, test_loss_cost_metrics
)
```

```{r module-2-module3-profile, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 12. LEAKAGE-SAFE 2025 MODULE 3 PRICING PROFILE ------------------------------
# The 2021-2024 cohorts exist only to develop the technical pricing model.
# The canonical downstream quote-market population is the untouched 2025 cohort.
# All current-year claims outcomes are removed, including both 2025-basis and
# nominal aliases retained by Module 1 for audit purposes.
current_year_outcome_columns <- c( "claim_count", "pricing_claim_count", "incurred_claim_cost",
  "reconstructed_incurred_claim_cost", "gross_claim_cost", "average_paid_claim_cost",
  "pricing_average_paid_claim_cost", "largest_paid_claim", "total_loss_claim_count", "any_total_loss",
  "reconstructed_reported_claim_count", "incurred_claim_cost_nominal", "gross_claim_cost_nominal",
  "average_paid_claim_cost_nominal", "largest_paid_claim_nominal" )
module3_pricing_profiles <- evaluation_data %>% filter(policy_year == config$test_year) %>% select(
    -any_of(current_year_outcome_columns), -excess_factor, -prior_claims_band, -log_annual_km, -log_vehicle_value )
downstream_outcome_leakage <- intersect( current_year_outcome_columns, names(module3_pricing_profiles) )
downstream_truth_leakage <- names(module3_pricing_profiles)[str_detect( names(module3_pricing_profiles),
  regex("^true_|frailty|^latent_", ignore_case = TRUE) )]
if (nrow(module3_pricing_profiles) != expected_test_rows) {
  stop( "Canonical Module 3 profile must contain exactly the 10,000-policy 2025 cohort." )
}
if (!all(module3_pricing_profiles$policy_year == config$test_year)) {
  stop("Non-2025 policies remain in the canonical Module 3 pricing profile.")
}
if (!all(as.character(module3_pricing_profiles$data_split) == "test")) {
  stop("Canonical Module 3 pricing profile is not exclusively the 2025 TEST cohort.")
}
if (length(downstream_outcome_leakage) > 0L) {
  stop( "Current-year outcomes remain in Module 3 pricing profile: ",
    paste(downstream_outcome_leakage, collapse = ", ") )
}
if (length(downstream_truth_leakage) > 0L) {
  stop( "Truth/latent variables remain in Module 3 pricing profile: ",
    paste(downstream_truth_leakage, collapse = ", ") )
}
```

```{r module-2-summary, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}

    "Mean estimated positive-paid claim severity - all cohorts",
    "Mean estimated expected claims cost - all cohorts", "Mean technical premium - all cohorts",
    "Mean estimated expected claims cost - 2025 quote market", "Mean technical premium - 2025 quote market",
    "Median technical premium - 2025 quote market", "P95 technical premium - 2025 quote market",
    "Minimum technical premium - 2025 quote market", "Maximum technical premium - 2025 quote market",
    "2025 out-of-time test positive-paid frequency O/E", "2025 out-of-time test positive-paid severity O/E",
    "2025 out-of-time test loss-cost O/E" ), value = as.character(c( nrow(evaluation_data),
    nrow(module3_pricing_profiles), claims_cost_basis_label, frequency_definition_label, severity_definition_label,
    sum(modelling_data$claim_count), sum(modelling_data$pricing_claim_count), zero_paid_reported_claims,
    paste0(min(config$training_years), "-", max(config$training_years)), config$validation_year,
    paste0(min(config$training_years), "-", config$validation_year), config$test_year, nrow(training_data),
    nrow(validation_data), nrow(development_data), nrow(test_data), selected_frequency_model_name,
    selected_severity_model_name, frequency_uses_motive_power, severity_uses_motive_power,

    frequency_spec_improvement, severity_spec_improvement, frequency_dispersion, severity_dispersion,
    frequency_balance_factor, severity_balance_factor, config$technical_loading,
    mean(evaluation_data$estimated_claim_frequency), mean(evaluation_data$estimated_claim_severity),
    mean(evaluation_data$estimated_expected_claim_cost), mean(evaluation_data$technical_premium),
    mean(module3_pricing_profiles$estimated_expected_claim_cost), mean(module3_pricing_profiles$technical_premium),
    median(module3_pricing_profiles$technical_premium),
    quantile(module3_pricing_profiles$technical_premium, 0.95, names = FALSE),
    min(module3_pricing_profiles$technical_premium), max(module3_pricing_profiles$technical_premium),
    test_frequency_metrics$observed_to_expected, test_severity_metrics$observed_to_expected,
    test_loss_cost_metrics$observed_to_expected )) )
```

```{r module-2-truth-recovery, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 14. SYNTHETIC-TRUTH RECOVERY — EVALUATION ONLY ------------------------------
# The truth file is deliberately opened only after model selection, 2021-2024
# refitting/balancing, 2025 TEST prediction and the downstream Module 3 profile
# are complete.
truth_recovery <- tibble(metric = character(), value = numeric())
truth_file_used <- FALSE
if (file.exists(config$truth_file)) {
  truth_data <- safe_read_rds(config$truth_file, "Module 1 truth file")
  assert_columns( truth_data, c( "policy_id", "policy_year", "data_split",
      "true_annual_loss_cost", "true_technical_premium" ), "synthetic_motor_full_truth.rds" )
  truth_test <- truth_data %>% mutate(policy_year = as.integer(policy_year)) %>%
    filter(policy_year == config$test_year) %>%
    select(policy_id, true_annual_loss_cost, true_technical_premium) %>% inner_join(
      test_results %>% select(policy_id, estimated_expected_claim_cost, technical_premium), by = "policy_id" )
  if (nrow(truth_test) != nrow(test_results)) {
    stop("Truth-recovery join did not preserve all held-out 2025 TEST policies.")
  }
  truth_recovery <- tibble( metric = c( "2025 test Spearman correlation: estimated vs true annual loss cost",
      "2025 test mean estimated / true annual loss cost", "2025 test RMSE: estimated vs true annual loss cost",
      "2025 test MAE: estimated vs true annual loss cost",
      "2025 test Spearman correlation: technical premium vs true technical premium",
      "2025 test mean technical premium / true technical premium" ), value = c(
      cor(truth_test$estimated_expected_claim_cost, truth_test$true_annual_loss_cost, method = "spearman"),
      safe_divide(mean(truth_test$estimated_expected_claim_cost), mean(truth_test$true_annual_loss_cost)),
      rmse(truth_test$true_annual_loss_cost, truth_test$estimated_expected_claim_cost),
      mae(truth_test$true_annual_loss_cost, truth_test$estimated_expected_claim_cost),
      cor(truth_test$technical_premium, truth_test$true_technical_premium, method = "spearman"),
      safe_divide(mean(truth_test$technical_premium), mean(truth_test$true_technical_premium)) ) )
  truth_file_used <- TRUE
}
```


```{r module-2-validation, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 15. VALIDATION CHECKS --------------------------------------------------------
technical_pricing_validation_checks <- tribble(
  ~check_name, ~observed_value, ~lower_bound, ~upper_bound, ~required_for_progress,
  "Input policy rows", nrow(modelling_data), 50000, 50000, TRUE,
  "Unique policy IDs", n_distinct(modelling_data$policy_id), nrow(modelling_data), nrow(modelling_data), TRUE,
  "Policy years 2021-2025 present",
    as.numeric(setequal(sort(unique(modelling_data$policy_year)), 2021:2025)), 1, 1, TRUE,
  "Exact out-of-time split mapping",
    as.numeric(all(as.character(modelling_data$data_split) == expected_split_by_year)), 1, 1, TRUE,
  "Required train-validation-test splits", length(unique(as.character(modelling_data$data_split))), 3, 3, TRUE,
  "Training rows 2021-2023", nrow(training_data), expected_training_rows, expected_training_rows, TRUE,
  "Validation rows 2024", nrow(validation_data), expected_validation_rows, expected_validation_rows, TRUE,
  "Development rows 2021-2024", nrow(development_data), expected_development_rows, expected_development_rows, TRUE,
  "Test rows 2025", nrow(test_data), expected_test_rows, expected_test_rows, TRUE,
  "No 2025 policies in development", sum(development_data$policy_year == config$test_year), 0, 0, TRUE,
  "No development-test policy overlap", length(development_test_overlap), 0, 0, TRUE,
  "Technical-pricing claims cost basis year", config$cost_basis_year, 2025, 2025, TRUE,
  "Reported claim counts reconcile to claim-level file", reported_count_mismatch, 0, 0, TRUE,
  "Maximum policy incurred-cost reconstruction difference", incurred_reconstruction_error, 0, 0.011, TRUE,
  "Positive-paid claims do not exceed reported claims",
    as.numeric(all(modelling_data$pricing_claim_count <= modelling_data$claim_count)), 1, 1, TRUE,
  "Positive-paid severity values valid", as.numeric(all( is.finite( modelling_data$pricing_average_paid_claim_cost[
          modelling_data$pricing_claim_count > 0 ] ) & modelling_data$pricing_average_paid_claim_cost[
        modelling_data$pricing_claim_count > 0 ] > 0 )), 1, 1, TRUE,
  "Unsupported training factor levels", nrow(unsupported_training_levels), 0, 0, TRUE,
  "Motive power present in Module 1 input", as.numeric("motive_power" %in% names(modelling_data)), 1, 1, TRUE,
  "CarExpert vehicle-spec fields present in Module 1 input", as.numeric(all(c(
      "engine_capacity_l", "cylinder_count", "power_kw", "torque_nm", "unladen_weight_kg", "transmission"
    ) %in% names(modelling_data))), 1, 1, TRUE,
  "Finite positive power", mean(is.finite(modelling_data$power_kw) & modelling_data$power_kw > 0), 1, 1, TRUE,
  "Finite positive torque", mean(is.finite(modelling_data$torque_nm) & modelling_data$torque_nm > 0), 1, 1, TRUE,
  "Finite positive unladen weight",
    mean(is.finite(modelling_data$unladen_weight_kg) & modelling_data$unladen_weight_kg > 0), 1, 1, TRUE,
  "All motive-power levels supported in training",
    nrow(unsupported_training_levels %>% filter(variable == "motive_power")), 0, 0, TRUE,
  "All transmission levels supported in training",
    nrow(unsupported_training_levels %>% filter(variable == "transmission")), 0, 0, TRUE,
  "Final frequency model converged", as.numeric(isTRUE(final_frequency_model$converged)), 1, 1, TRUE,
  "Final severity model converged", as.numeric(isTRUE(final_severity_model$converged)), 1, 1, TRUE,
  "Finite positive technical premiums",
    mean(is.finite(evaluation_data$technical_premium) & evaluation_data$technical_premium > 0), 1, 1, TRUE,
  "Canonical Module 3 pricing-profile rows",
    nrow(module3_pricing_profiles), expected_test_rows, expected_test_rows, TRUE,
  "Canonical Module 3 profile contains 2025 only",
    as.numeric(all(module3_pricing_profiles$policy_year == config$test_year)), 1, 1, TRUE,
  "Canonical Module 3 profile contains TEST split only",
    as.numeric(all(as.character(module3_pricing_profiles$data_split) == "test")), 1, 1, TRUE,
  "Current-year outcomes absent from Module 3 profile", length(downstream_outcome_leakage), 0, 0, TRUE,
  "Truth/latent variables absent from Module 3 profile", length(downstream_truth_leakage), 0, 0, TRUE,
  "Motive power retained in Module 3 profile",
    as.numeric("motive_power" %in% names(module3_pricing_profiles)), 1, 1, TRUE,
  "CarExpert vehicle-spec fields retained in Module 3 profile", as.numeric(all(c(
      "engine_capacity_l", "cylinder_count", "power_kw", "torque_nm", "unladen_weight_kg", "transmission"
    ) %in% names(module3_pricing_profiles))), 1, 1, TRUE, "2025 out-of-time test positive-paid frequency O/E",
    test_frequency_metrics$observed_to_expected,
    config$test_frequency_oe_lower, config$test_frequency_oe_upper, TRUE,
  "2025 out-of-time test positive-paid severity O/E", test_severity_metrics$observed_to_expected,
    config$test_severity_oe_lower, config$test_severity_oe_upper, TRUE, "2025 out-of-time test loss-cost O/E",
    test_loss_cost_metrics$observed_to_expected,
    config$test_loss_cost_oe_lower, config$test_loss_cost_oe_upper, TRUE ) %>%
  mutate(pass = observed_value >= lower_bound & observed_value <= upper_bound)
failed_required_checks <- technical_pricing_validation_checks %>% filter(required_for_progress, !pass)
if (nrow(failed_required_checks) > 0L) {
  warning("At least one required Module 2 validation check failed. Review the validation CSV before Module 3.")
}
```
